title: Daily Signal Brief 009 — Workday went MCP-native + Agent Passport (Cisco); Mobley shields bias data; EU-PTD T-2
summary: Three signals, top alert L4. (1) Delayed catch — Workday DevCon on 2026-06-02 launched Workday Build with Agent-Ready Tools over Model Context Protocol and Agent Passport (third-party agent-safety verification, Cisco as inaugural verifier). MCP-native is now table stakes; Agent Passport directly challenges Kernel's eval-set-as-moat story. Eglin missed it in three consecutive briefs (6/2, 6/3, 6/4) and corrects today. (2) Mobley v. Workday discovery ruling of 2026-05-29 (Beeler, N.D. Cal.) denied plaintiffs' motion to compel Workday's bias-testing data on attorney-client-privilege grounds, denied motion to compel customer applicant data on FRCP Rule 34 control grounds, ordered EEO-1/OFCCP produced. The vendor playbook for hiding AI bias data is now legally public — Stratum's published-in-the-open eval set becomes a commercial differentiator, not just a virtue. (3) EU-PTD at T-2 days: Italy and Slovakia transposed; Germany, France, Spain, Netherlands, Denmark, Ireland have all publicly conceded they will miss; targets range late-2026 to 2027-01-01. Six confirmed misses (up from two yesterday), eighteen indeterminate. Recommendations route to Helm (next-Briefing paragraph on eval-set differentiation), Kernel and Forge (Agent Passport vs. eval-set comparison + trust-center update by 6/12-6/15), Compass (prospect-deck Workday-eval-set-privileged slide + corrected EU-PTD country list by 6/8), Vector (Germany-misses talking point for office hours 6/9). Watch-list refresh now overdue; Eglin will ship by 6/8.
